title: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
summary: OpenAI completed a $7 billion tender offer for employees, allowing staff to liquidate equity holdings. The massive transaction reflects the company's substantial valuation and ongoing competition for AI talent.

zh.title: OpenAI据报完成了70亿美元员工股权收购
zh.summary: OpenAI完成了一项70亿美元的员工股权收购，允许员工清算其股权持有。这笔巨大交易反映了该公司的巨大估值和对AI人才的持续竞争。
